core.title: Mortise Lock Conversion Plate, Don-Jo CV-8624

text.description_html:
Don-Jo CV-8624-PC, Mortise Lock Conversion Plate

This filler plate allows for the conversion from an 86 cut out (mortise lock) to two (2) 161 cut outs (standard tube latch and deadbolt latch).

Also available: With single hole, Don-Jo CV-86 Mortise Lock Conversion Plate

Just remove the old Mortise Lock box. Screw the filler plate into the doors edge existing mortise lock holes. You can now install a standard latch and deadbolt latch.

Specifications for the Don-Jo CV-8624-PC Mortise Conversion Plate:

  • Plate Height: 8"
  • Plate Width: 1-1/4"
  • Latch Hole Spacing: 4" Center to Center
  • Screws: (2) each #12-24 x 1/2" Flat Head Machine Screws
  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Primer
  • Don-Jo CV-8624 Conversion Plate Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
